name: Pipecat
summary: Open-source Python framework from Daily for realtime voice and multimodal agents: composable pipelines, 80+ AI service integrations, multi-agent handoffs and client SDKs.
description: Build voice agents as pipelines of processors (transport, STT, LLM, TTS) over WebRTC or WebSockets, or compose many pipelines into multi-agent systems with handoff, parallel fan-out and sidecars over a shared bus. Pipecat Flows (built in) adds structured conversation paths. Client SDKs for JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, C++ and ESP32; tooling includes the `pipecat` CLI (`pipecat init` scaffolds a project for Claude Code or Codex), the Whisker debugger, Pipecat UI components and Claude Code skills (`claude plugin marketplace add pipecat-ai/skills`). Hosting is optional: Pipecat Cloud by Daily charges from $0.01 per active agent minute (agent-1x) with unlimited concurrency; you bring your own LLM/STT/TTS providers.

agent_access.notes: Framework itself needs no key; you supply keys for the AI services you plug in. Pipecat Cloud uses a Daily account.
